map.把外币退税折算人民币，看清实际到手收益（扣手续费后）。: Convert foreign-currency refunds to CNY to see the actual take-home benefit (after deducting fees).

map.以「日本购物 10 万日元、汇率 0.048、单店满 5000 日元退 10%」: Example: "Japan shopping 100,000 JPY, exchange rate 0.048, single store over 5,000 JPY refunds 10%"
map.达起退点，可退税款=10万×10%=1万日元；退税公司手续费约 5%=500 日: Reaches threshold: refundable tax = 100,000 × 10% = 10,000 JPY; refund company fee about 5% = 500 JPY; actual refund = 9,500 JPY ≈ ¥456 (at 0.048). Germany (19%, threshold 25 EUR) shopping 2,000 EUR: refund 380 EUR, fee 19 EUR, actual refund 361 EUR ≈ ¥2,815.8. The US has no federal tax refund; the tool prompts to consult locally.
map.退税是按消费全额还是超额？: Is the refund on the full amount or only the excess?
map.多数国家对达起退点后的消费全额按退税率计算（如日本 10%、德国 19%），并非: Most countries calculate the refund on the full amount after reaching the threshold (e.g. Japan 10%, Germany 19%), not only the excess; if the threshold is not reached (e.g. Japan single store < 5,000 JPY) no refund. Some countries also have per-receipt or per-store thresholds.
map.手续费为什么会吃掉退税？: Why does the fee eat into the refund?
map.机场退税公司或商家代理通常收取约 5%（或固定费）服务费，大额消费占比小、小额消: Airport refund companies or merchant agents usually charge about 5% (or a fixed fee) service fee; the share is small for large purchases and high for small ones; credit card refund exchange rates may also have discounts. It is recommended to concentrate large amounts at refundable stores and compare cash vs credit card refund arrival differences.
